page.layout: One photograph of a closed book seen from its fore-edge, with the boards and page block visible. No printed text block. The digitiser's credit caption at the foot of the image is excluded.
page.notes: The scan shows a book lying on its side, photographed from the edge. The page block shows only the stacked leaf edges and the boards. No printed words appear on this image. The only text is the digitiser's credit line (ProQuest / Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Firenze, shelf mark CFMAGL 2.6.498), which is not transcribed.
